findings.title: Wrapped footer links overlap and misdirect visible-text clicks
findings.observed: 320/390 CSSpx, light/dark:43.796875px target rectangles stacked23.796875px apart overlap20px. Clicking two pixels above the bottom of visible Universal Law text dispatches Library.1200px geometry has no overlap.
findings.cause: display:inline-block; padding:10px 2px; margin:-10px 0 expands hit boxes without reserving line spacing.
findings.recommendation: Remove the collision while retaining separated targets; validate real hit destinations and target spacing at320/390/light/dark. Auditor makes no product edit.
findings.qualification: axe reports effective23.8px target size/spacing under24px. Manually reproduced navigation defect independently of that threshold. These are styled navigation links, not an ordinary prose-link size exception.

findings.title: Focus-enabled graph viewport has a label without a valid named role in source failure
findings.observed: Intentional local current.json fetch failure leaves tabindex=0 div with aria-label and no valid role; axe aria-prohibited-attr reports a violation.
findings.recommendation: Give the intended scroll viewport an appropriate valid named role and retain its source-failure boundary. Review separately labelled generic toolbar/status containers; their normal-state results are incomplete, not proven speech failures.
findings.qualification: An invalid ARIA structure and automated criterion finding, not an observed screen-reader speech failure. This test intentionally aborts current.json; it is not the missing-capture-assets incident.

findings.criterion: 1.3.1/2.4.6 (not established as a definite AA failure)
findings.title: Selected inspector H3 follows H1 when foundations disclosure is closed
findings.recommendation: An H2 such as Explore claims and evidence before the workbench supplies the missing hierarchy while retaining every #atlas-inspector h3 API. Prefer visible text; a visually hidden implementation must remain in the accessibility tree. No generic visually-hidden utility was found in the inspected baseline styles.
findings.qualification: axe heading-order has best-practice tags only; do not promote it into a definite WCAG AA failure.

findings.title: 3D relationship scroll list depends on browser implicit focus behavior
findings.recommendation: Explicit named keyboard-scroll semantics can make the intended interaction portable. Other browser/AT qualification remains necessary.
findings.qualification: axe flags scrollable-region-focusable at390px, but real Chromium154 Tab focuses the UL and ArrowDown scrolls0→40px at320/390 in both themes. UA visible outline is present. Not a demonstrated keyboard failure in this browser.

findings.title: Unresolved automated contrast and generic-role coverage
findings.qualification: Normal labelled generic containers remain axe incomplete. Pseudo-element/overlap contrast nodes remain incomplete;28 representative solid computed-color samples range6.28–17.27 and exceed4.5, but do not settle every painted pixel, graph edge, pseudo element or other AT implementation.
